R5.arithmetic: Steps name 1x2 for back slats (steps[7] 'Cut pieces of 1x2 to fit') and arm slats (steps[12]). Needed: 12 x 9 = 108 + 8 x 14.75 = 118 + 12 x 16 = 192 = 418". Bought: materials[4] quantity 4 x 96" = 384". 418 > 384 even with zero kerf (short 34"; 31 cuts x 1/8 = 3.875 more). Other stocks checked and cover: 2x8 2x32 + 29.5 = 93.5 + kerf <= 96; 2x6 3 x 29.5 = 88.5 <= 96; 2x4 2x52 + 4x16 = 168 + kerf <= 192; 1x4 4 x 55 = 220 <= 240; 2x2 2 x 15.5 + 19 = 50 <= 96.

R6.reason: Sweep flag is a false positive (16" is a part length). Steps use 2 1/2" and 1 1/4" pocket screws, 1 1/4" exterior screws, 2"+ brad nails - all in materials[6..9].

R10.reason: Seat-support height 16 1/4" (steps[5],[9]), slat gap 1 7/8" (steps[7]), support spacing 16" (steps[10]); other placements relational or shown in viewed image 89aaeb18299d0f9a ('as the picture shows').

R9.reason: Each pocket-hole instruction names the thickness: steps[1] 'Drill 1 ½” pocket holes' on 2x stock; steps[8] 'drill ¾” pocket holes' on 1x2; no contradiction.
